description: Match engine output Lexicon per ADR-2605282200 — emitted by Pregel cell `kawase_pool_match` once per matched deposit. Records WHICH of the two settlement modes was used (matched against a counter-intent vs disbursed from reserve buffer), the mKOTO debit accrued for the cell's compute, and the FX rate attestation CID for replay. silenKawaseReview aggregates these to compute matchedSharePctIntegerHundredths (G5 target ≥80% at R2+).

matchEpoch.description: Pregel cell epoch number at which the match was executed.

settlementMode.description: matched = counter withdrawIntent satisfied the deposit (no reserve consumed). reserve-disbursed = no counter intent within match_window_seconds; reserve buffer disbursed at locked rate. Pool drift_bps increments on reserve-disbursed flows.

tgtIntentCid.description: withdrawIntent.intentCid of the matched counter-intent. ABSENT when settlementMode = reserve-disbursed.

fxRateBps.description: Rate locked at depositAttestation creation. MUST be identical to depositAttestation.fxRateBps.

mKotoDebitAmount.description: mKOTO debited from operator DID balance per ADR-2605282100 for this match cell tick. Royalty pool credit emitted symmetrically.

executingCellDid.description: DID of the Murakumo fleet node that executed this match cell tick. MUST be a fleet.toml-listed node per G12 + ADR-2605215000.
